title: A Merge Commit
objective: Diverge two branches, merge them, and print the merge commit's subject and its parent count.
hint: Commit on main, then on notes, then back on main with a second commit on LICENSE.md. Then git merge -q --no-edit notes. Then Write-Output with (git log -1 --format=%s). Then $parents = (git rev-list --parents -n 1 HEAD).Split(" ").Count - 1 and Write-Output Parents: with $parents.
